Hi Mina / Vanessa,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. Contoso is ready for the Partner Center referral wave next quarter and I want to align on how we’ll tile the account set and assign seller ownership so referrals route cleanly and attribution shows up for the field.

Two asks to unblock:
1) Can you share the recommended account tiling (how you want to split the Contoso account universe across region/BUs and primary owner)?
2) We need the mapping file to ingest into Partner Center (primary owner, secondary owner, 10-digit partner ID) and any fallback rules for orphaned accounts.

I’ve attached the Partner Center referral policy PDF for reference (high level rules on ownership precedence). If we can confirm the tiling + a short import CSV by EOD Tuesday I can queue the referral import and schedule a validation test next week with Contoso.

Attachment: partnercenter-referral-policy.pdf (summary of referral precedence and seller credit rules)

Suggested meeting: Tue 11/24 10:30 PT to walk through the import and test case. Let me know if that works.

—Rachel

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>

Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Nov 2026 11:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Azure Partner Center: Contoso tiling + seller ownership

Thanks Rachel — we can get this over. High level approach below and I’ve attached a working roster CSV (contoso_account_roster.csv) with the first-pass owner assignments.

Proposed tiling rules (first pass):
- Tier A (>$250k ARR): regional lead as primary owner, national AE as secondary.
- Tier B ($50k–$250k): segment AE primary, regional SDR as secondary for discovery.
- Tier C (<$50k): partner-led; referral flag to marketplace ops to allow partner self-serve routing.

Referral routing/fallback policy: primary owner wins when Partner Center referral flag present. If primary owner is not enabled in Partner Center, fallback to secondary. If both unavailable, route to Marketplace Ops (orphan queue) with a 48hr SLA to reassign.

Notes / open items:
- We need the 10-digit partner IDs for seller accounts to ensure Partner Center matching — Karthik, can you export SKU IDs and partner IDs from the Marketplace roster?
- For multi-region Contoso entities (EMEA/APAC), we’ll mark those rows and exclude them from this US tiling import.

Attachment: contoso_account_roster.csv (columns: account_id, account_name, tier, primary_owner, primary_partner_id, secondary_owner, notes)

If Rachel can confirm the policy doc aligns with MSFT precedence, I’ll finalize the CSV and push to Partner Center import format by EOD Tuesday. The Tue 11/24 10:30 PT time works for me.

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Head of Partnerships — Redwood Inference
